messages.content: What are the office hours for the downtown branch?
Downtown branch: Mon-Fri 9AM-5PM, Sat 10AM-2PM, closed Sunday. Address: 100 Main St, Suite 200. Phone: (555) 123-4567.

The downtown branch hours are:
- Monday to Friday: 9 AM – 5 PM
- Saturday: 10 AM – 2 PM
- Closed on Sundays

The branch is located at 100 Main St, Suite 200. You can also reach them at (555) 123-4567.
Can I visit on Saturday at 1 PM?
Yes, the downtown branch is open on Saturdays until 2 PM, so a 1 PM visit would be within their hours.
